description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for retrieving time report data within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base ReportDataAPI class and handles request parameters, response schema annotations, and mapping report names to specific report classes.

classes.name: TimeReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class for fetching time report data including request parameter definitions and report class mapping.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to map report names to specific report classes and handle invalid report name errors.
